statement: This sketch creates a structured grid representation of the periodic table of elements, arranged in a 10×18 matrix. Each element tile is rendered with a distinct hue from the color spectrum, creating a visually coherent yet diverse palette. The entire structure is bathed in a continuous ambient glow that travels across the grid like undulating sine waves. This wave effect moves smoothly from one edge to the opposite, with each element's brightness modulated by its position and the global time offset. The emerald green hue of the glow is achieved through careful color manipulation using HSB color space, creating a vibrant yet cohesive visual field that pulses gently without requiring any user interaction.
